notes.title: New Option mouse sensitivity + Simple Interface
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34242556/98331ed724c288a6507ad6be64370e9f55287c3f.jpg
About the update:

 The description of some buttons was changed by symbols easy to understand in any language.
 An option was added to modify the sensitivity of the mouse.
 The initial sensitivity of the mouse changed from 33 to 45.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34242556/c784f3b10166e2ec2d35ef652e25cdafe0f4e6e3.jpg

Possible mistakes:
If the game does not leave the intro with the message "SaveGame found", you must do the following:


Close and open the game again.
If the problem persists close the game. ːsteamsadː
Delete the options.sav file in the path: 
C:\Users\(you_user_pc)\AppData\Local\VOT\Saved\SaveGames
Open the game again. 
The game will create a new file options.sav ːsteamhappyː
Enjoy the game. :Subxanima:



This error occurs because there already exists options.sav and the game can not replace it correctly.
This error should not occur if it is the first time TLOM plays, if this is the case, please send a message to support.
